sources.entry: ownCloud - All-in-one solution for saving, synchronizing, viewing, editing and sharing files, calendars, address books and more. (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker/deb

summary.one_liner: ownCloud Core is the server-side component of ownCloud Classic, a PHP-based self-hosted platform for file storage, sync, and sharing.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes ownCloud Core as the server component of ownCloud Classic, providing file storage, synchronization, and sharing. It states the server includes WebDAV, CalDAV, and CardDAV servers, a plugin architecture for apps, user and group management, encryption support, external storage backends, and a REST API. It runs on PHP and supports MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite. The README says apps such as Activity, Calendar, and Contacts extend it, and that a Docker image is available on Docker Hub. A development build is started with make, requiring Composer v2 and Yarn with Node.js v14 or higher.
use_cases: host a private cloud file server
team file sharing with access control
how_to_run: Install ownCloud Classic using the official installation manual (linked from the README)
For a development build, install Composer v2 and Yarn with Node.js v14 or higher
Run make in the repository root
notable: Provides WebDAV, CalDAV, and CardDAV servers in one server
Plugin architecture that apps such as Calendar and Contacts extend
Supports external storage backends and encryption
Available as an official Docker image on Docker Hub
Main repository for ownCloud Classic; next-generation platform is ownCloud Infinite Scale (oCIS)
caveats: The README states the project is under a planned relicensing toward Apache 2.0; the current license is AGPL-3.0 and migration prerequisites are listed as incomplete
Development build requires several toolchains (Composer v2, Yarn, Node.js 14+)
Contributions require signed commits and DCO sign-off
